# VerticalAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Vertical alignment options for layout elements.

The counterpart to `HorizontalAlignment`. Meaningful on a container that has more vertical room than its child needs - typically one given an explicit Height - which is what makes it possible to anchor content to the bottom of a fixed box without hand-computing a top padding.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Start`: Align to the top
- `Center`: Align to the middle
- `End`: Align to the bottom
- `Stretch`: Stretch to fill available space
